+# Inheriting selected upstream templates
+
+A downstream Jinja template can inherit the package's selected `www-from-model` source.
+For example, set `homepage.template` in `projection.yaml` to `site-specific/templates/homepage.md.j2` and put this in that file:
+
+```jinja
+{% extends "www-from-model:page_templates/homepage.md.j2" %}
+{% block content %}
+{{ super() }}
+
+Additional editorial content.
+{% endblock %}
+```
+
+This preserves upstream frontmatter, objectives, relationships, and `params.graphRootNodePID`.
+`super()` preserves the parent's content before the addition.
+Override another named upstream block only when replacing that block is intentional.
+The existing homepage content block suffices for appending editorial content; inserting content between its sections requires upstream extension points.
+
+Qualified `extends`, `include`, and import references are relative to the selected source root.
+Unqualified dependencies inside an upstream template are relative to that template's directory and stay in the selected source.
+Local templates retain their existing directory lookup.
+Paths must be normalized POSIX paths without `..`; use a qualified path to refer to another upstream directory.
+Missing parents and invalid paths fail rendering with the record PID and requested template.
+
+Editable installations use the actual nested working checkout.
+Installed distributions use their bundled rendering resources.
+Website projection and editor preparation use the same renderer; neither requires copying upstream parents into the downstream.

+class _ProjectionEnvironment(Environment):
+    def join_path(self, template: str, parent: str) -> str:
+        prefix = "www-from-model:"
+        if parent.startswith(prefix) and not template.startswith(prefix):
+            directory = PurePosixPath(parent.removeprefix(prefix)).parent
+            return prefix + (directory / template).as_posix()
+        return template

+    def test_local_template_inherits_selected_upstream_blocks(self) -> None:
+        upstream = self.resources / "www-from-model"
+        templates = upstream / "page_templates"
+        templates.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (templates / "base.j2").write_text(
+            "{% block params %}upstream {{ display_label }}{% endblock %}",
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        (templates / "person.j2").write_text(
+            '{% extends "base.j2" %}', encoding="utf-8"
+        )
+        local = self.root / "site-specific/projection-templates/person.j2"
+        local.write_text(
+            '{% extends "www-from-model:page_templates/person.j2" %}'
+            '{% block params %}{{ super() }}; local{% endblock %}',
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        # An upstream dependency must not pick up a same-named local file.
+        (local.parent / "base.j2").write_text("wrong source", encoding="utf-8")
+        policy = RenderPolicy(local, {}, (), ())
+        rendered = _render_record(
+            {"pid": "acme:people/one", "display_label": "One"},

 class UpstreamProjectionTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_inherited_homepage_preserves_upstream_metadata_and_content(self):
+        from orinoco_lite.projection import _render_record, RenderPolicy
+        import yaml
+
+        upstream = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "submodules/www-from-model"
+        record = {
+            "pid": "xyzrins:.", "title": "Example", "description": "Description",
+            "parts": [{"pid": "xyzrins:projects/one", "schema_type": "xyzri:XYZProject"}],
+            "influenced_by": [{"object": {
+                "pid": "xyzrins:objectives/open", "schema_type": "xyzri:XYZObjective",
+                "title": "Open research",
+            }, "roles": []}],
+            "associated_with": [], "generated": [],
+        }
+        parent = RenderPolicy(upstream / "page_templates/homepage.md.j2", {}, (), ())
+        expected = _render_record(record, parent, {}, [], upstream)
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
+            child = Path(temporary) / "homepage.md.j2"
+            child.write_text(
+                '{% extends "www-from-model:page_templates/homepage.md.j2" %}'
+                '{% block content %}{{ super() }}Editorial addition.{% endblock %}'
+            )
+            actual = _render_record(record, RenderPolicy(child, {}, (), ()), {}, [], upstream)
+        frontmatter = yaml.safe_load(actual.split("---", 2)[1])
+        self.assertEqual(frontmatter, yaml.safe_load(expected.split("---", 2)[1]))
+        self.assertEqual(frontmatter["params"]["graphRootNodePID"], "xyzrins:.")
+        self.assertEqual(frontmatter["objectives"], ["open"])
+        self.assertEqual(frontmatter["projects"], ["one"])
+        self.assertIn("[Open research](/objectives/open)", actual)
+        self.assertIn(expected.split("---", 2)[2], actual)
+        self.assertIn("Editorial addition.", actual)
+
